name: No Mana, Just Dice
description:
About This Game

"Heh heh... Behold the providence of darkness..." (Please, anything but a 1!)

Meet the disgrace of a prestigious magical family: a 'Zero Mana' dropout witch. All she has are massive debt and a set of 'sketchy, defective dice' bought from a loan shark. To overturn her miserable fate, she reluctantly enters the dungeon to find the legendary 'Wish-Granting Scroll.'

She acts like a cool, dark mage on the outside, but inside? She’s trembling in her boots. At every crossroads of fear, guide her with your 'Perfect Strategy!'

The Cowardly Witch's Dilemma 

"Use the dice to run, or use them to fight?"

  • Perfect Information: Enemy actions are 100% telegraphed. Find the optimal ratio between movement and offense each turn.

  • Desperate Resource Management: You hold only 4 dice. Use a high roll to sprint away, and you lose firepower. Go all-in on the attack, and you're a sitting duck. Every die counts.

You can't control the odds, but you can design the outcome.

If the dice won't listen, just change the 'Scroll'.

  • Rethinking Dice Values: Every scroll interprets numbers differently. A generic '1' could be a failure on one scroll, but a critical hit on another.

  • 4 Scrolls, Condensed Strategy: You can only bring 4 scrolls into battle. Find the perfect balance between range, AoE (Area of Effect), survival, and impact.

Game Summary

  • Dice-Driven Tactics: A desperate survival roguelike where every action—from walking to striking—hinges on your dice rolls.

  • Telegraphed Combat: Enemy intents are fully visible. Enjoy the strategic thrill of allocating limited dice between 'Survival (Move)' and 'Impact (Attack).'

  • Dynamic Scroll Deck-Building: Collect scrolls that change range and effects based on dice values. Control every variable with a compact deck of 4 scrolls.
short_desc: Zero Mana. Massive Debt. No Mana, Just Dice is a tactical turn-based roguelike. Play as a dropout witch who needs dice just to take a single step! Use your limited dice to maneuver and attack, outsmart your bad luck, and seize the wish-granting scroll to rewrite your fate.
